Sandbox_HotwireTools_Screwdrivers_toolti: Items that count as a screwdriver, separated by semicolons. The multitool counts as both tools.
Sandbox_HotwireTools_Pliers_tooltip: Items that count as pliers, separated by semicolons. The multitool counts as both tools.
Sandbox_HotwireTools_BurglarNoTools_tool: Characters with the Burglar occupation can hotwire without a screwdriver or pliers.
